title: Function gate in the circuit
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ and $k,t\in\mathbb{N}$, with $t<2^{2^k}$. The gate at index $o_F(n,k)+t$ is the function gate with bases $n+o_F(n,k)$ and $n+o_Z(n,k)$, parameter $k$, and index parameter $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ bits
